sections.label: Singapore car ownership statistics
sections.summary: As of 2015, Singapore had about 540,000 passenger cars, with 45% of households owning at least one car and 8% owning more than one.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Teng Koon (Marsiling-Yew Tee)
sentences.text: To briefly recap the current situation, as of 2015, we had about 540,000 passenger cars registered in Singapore.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Teng Koon (Marsiling-Yew Tee)
sentences.text: From the data, approximately 45% of households own at least one car, while 8% of households own more than one.

sections.label: Additional Buyer's Car Duty proposal
sections.summary: A proposal suggests an Additional Buyer's Car Duty, set as a percentage of COE price, for those buying a second, third or fourth car.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Teng Koon (Marsiling-Yew Tee)
sentences.text: Citizens looking to buy a second property pay an additional 7% stamp duty, which increases to 10% for the third or subsequent property.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Teng Koon (Marsiling-Yew Tee)
sentences.text: Could we not consider here an Additional Buyer's Car Duty (ABCD), which could be set as a percentage of the prevailing COE price, for those who wish to buy a second, third or fourth car?

sections.label: Global EV adoption and Norway
sections.summary: EV adoption is accelerating globally, led by Norway where around 30% of new cars registered are electric due to strong incentives.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Teng Koon (Marsiling-Yew Tee)
sentences.text: EV adoption is accelerating globally – the leader is Norway, where, due to strong incentives, around 30% of new cars registered are now electric.

sections.label: Charge points and commercial EVs
sections.summary: Charge points in most commercial buildings could serve as emergency top-ups, but reports suggest only around 100 commercially sold EVs exist.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Teng Koon (Marsiling-Yew Tee)
sentences.text: For those drivers, there are already charge points in most commercial buildings which could serve as emergency top-ups, if needed, providing additional security for users.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Teng Koon (Marsiling-Yew Tee)
sentences.text: However, if we look at the current state of the market, excluding vehicles participating in Government trials, new reports suggest that there are only around 100 commercially sold EVs.

sections.label: EV CO2 emissions estimate
sections.summary: LTA estimates a typical EV produces around 85 grams of CO2 per km because Singapore's electricity comes from natural gas.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Teng Koon (Marsiling-Yew Tee)
sentences.text: LTA estimates that the typical EV produces around 85 grams of CO2 per km because our electricity comes from natural gas.

sections.label: Charger installation cost benchmark
sections.summary: International benchmarks suggest installing such chargers should cost around $3,000, as slow overnight charging would be sufficient.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Teng Koon (Marsiling-Yew Tee)
sentences.text: International benchmarks suggest that the cost of installing such chargers should be around $3,000, as they do not need to be the fancy, expensive, fast or rapid charging type – slow charging overnight would be sufficient for us.

sections.label: New car sales and car-lite society
sections.summary: The passage expects 3% to 5% of new car sales, possibly higher in Singapore, and says this will not interfere with the car-lite society journey.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Teng Koon (Marsiling-Yew Tee)
sentences.text: It would not be unreasonable to expect the typical 3% to 5% of new car sales typically observed internationally, although my hunch is that we would see a higher end of the scale, given the driving patterns and fuel costs here in Singapore.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Teng Koon (Marsiling-Yew Tee)
sentences.text: This will in no way interfere with our journey towards a car-lite society, but just helps to make it a greener one for our future generations.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Teng Koon (Marsiling-Yew Tee)
sentences.text: I believe that our policies on the distribution of car ownership and the type of cars we drive can contribute to these goals.
